lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is observed posterior to the gill slits. The blobs are arranged in approximately nine visible vertical columns, with 4-6 primary centroids per column along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a series of grid-like nodes across the mid-section of the shark's flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible. The most prominent ridge displays a sharp luminance gradient, with higher-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a distinct shadow region below, spanning from the fifth gill slit towards the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains at least 7 distinct high-luminance blobs. These are non-uniformly distributed, with higher density observed towards the anterior edge and the base of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, high-luminance object with a ventral orientation to the shark, consistent with the pixel signature of a commensal teleost (e.g., Echeneidae).
